Hey Sara - we have an article on our website about conversion for those in the partner visa process. The answer will depend on what type of conversion you want to do (Orthodox, Masorti or Reform), what type of visa you have, and how long you have had it. https://aic.org.il/conversion-to-judaism-in-israel-a-practical-overview-for-mixed-couples/ 

But in short, if you want to do an Orthodox conversion and you are in Tel Aviv, I would recommend reaching out to the International Synagogue on Frishman. You should attend some of their services to see if you connect with it, but they do have a very organised conversion programme
